title: System and Method for Automated AI Grant Matching and Scoring
abstract: A computer-implemented method comprising receiving research profile metadata, encoding semantic embeddings of researcher interests, and calculating match scores against funding call criteria.

title: Distributed Vector Database System for Real-Time Patent Prior Art Search
abstract: An architecture for distributed high-dimensional approximate nearest neighbor search optimized for real-time patent prior art invalidation.

title: Neural Network Pipeline for Technology Readiness Level Estimation
abstract: System for parsing technical documents and outputting quantified readiness score distributions along with commercialization roadmap milestones.

title: Autonomous Multi-Agent System for Research Trend Discovery
abstract: A system of coordinated large language model agents configured to continuously crawl publication repositories, cluster topics, and output predictive trend charts.

title: Graph-Based University Enterprise Partnership Engine
abstract: A database apparatus for identifying synergistic collaboration opportunities between academic labs and enterprise research divisions.

title: Quantum-Enhanced Bibliometric Analysis Method
abstract: Method utilizing quantum annealing to detect community structures and influential hubs within large-scale scientific citation graphs.

title: Explainable Intellectual Property Valuation Engine
abstract: System generating interpretable financial valuations of early-stage patent portfolios based on citation velocity and technology domain growth.

title: Secure Federated Learning Architecture for Inter-University Clinical Data
abstract: Apparatus enabling federated gradient exchange across university medical centers without exposing raw patient data.
